sentences.en: Sami's lawyer told the jurors that cops arrested the wrong person.
sentences.zh: 萨米的律师告诉陪审员，警察抓错了人。

sentences.en: Sami had many jurors lobbying on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 萨米有许多人为他游说（注：此处可以理解为有众多支持者在陪审团面前为其辩护）。

sentences.en: Sami's lawyer wanted to create reasonable doubt in the minds of the jurors.
sentences.zh: 萨米的律师希望在陪审员心中制造合理的疑点。

senses.zh: 陪审员,审查委员,宣誓人,评委
